# Play — Long Division

- SudokuPad: [Long Division on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Long Division on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The killer cages are native f-puzzles constraints. f-puzzles has no polydivisible line, so each bracket is a cosmetic purple
line with a small filled circle on its first cell. The apps won't enforce the lines; the rules text covers them. I have not
opened the links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

Polydivisible lines, read from the dot: r3c1–r2c2–r1c2–r1c3–r1c4–r1c5; r6c3–r5c4–r4c4–r4c5–r4c6–r4c7; r9c5–r8c6–r7c6–r7c7–r7c8–r7c9.

Killer cages: 18: r2c3, r2c4, r2c5; 12: r5c5, r5c6, r5c7; 17: r8c7, r8c8, r8c9; 11: r1c2, r1c3; 8: r3c4, r3c5, r4c5; 7: r3c7, r3c8; 9: r3c9, r4c9; 17: r5c1, r6c1; 8: r1c7, r1c8.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
